# The external toolchain, installed identically by ci.yml and publish.yml.
#
# One file rather than two inline lists, because they drifted once already: publish.yml was
# still missing texlive-latex-extra after ci.yml gained it, which would have failed a release
# at the Test step, minutes in, with the OIDC exchange never reached.
#
# What each one is for:
#   texlive-latex-base         the LaTeX core
#   texlive-latex-extra        standalone.cls, which every emitted document begins with
#   texlive-latex-recommended  textcomp
#   texlive-pictures           tikz/pgf
#   texlive-science            siunitx (and, as a hard Depends, texlive-lang-greek -- 79 MB,
#                              over half this list's download, unavoidable while we use siunitx)
#   poppler-utils              pdftoppm, for the ink gate -- which reads the Skia PDF as well
#                              as the compiled TeX since M2.5
#   libfontconfig1             a hard runtime dependency of libSkiaSharp. Present on the hosted
#   libfreetype6               image today and pulled in by TeX besides, so this is belt and
#                              braces -- but a Skia backend that cannot load its native library
#                              takes out every raster gate at once, and naming the dependency
#                              costs nothing next to diagnosing it on a slimmer runner later.
#   ffmpeg                     the muxer D75 shells out to, and ffprobe, which is in the same
#                              package and is how the video gates read a container back. Without
#                              it every gate in VideoTests that needs a binary skips itself and
#                              says so -- which is right on a laptop and wrong here.
#   dvisvgm                    turns the DVI that `latex` writes into vector paths (D79). Its
#                              own package on Debian and Ubuntu, and NOT pulled in by any of the
#                              texlive entries above -- which is the same omission the Skia
#                              native assets made twice. `latex` itself comes from
#                              texlive-latex-base, alongside the pdflatex the TeX gates use.
#   xvfb                       a virtual X display, since M5 phase 4. The GPU renderer opens a
#                              hidden GLFW window for its OpenGL context, and a hosted runner has
#                              no display to open it on.
#   libgl1-mesa-dri            Mesa's DRI drivers, llvmpipe among them: OpenGL 3.3 core on the
#   libglx-mesa0               CPU, which is the only GPU a hosted runner has (D120). libglx-mesa0
#                              is the GLX side that GLFW asks for the context through.
#
# Changing this file changes the apt cache key in both workflows, so a package added here is
# fetched fresh once and then cached.
texlive-latex-base
texlive-latex-extra
texlive-latex-recommended
texlive-pictures
texlive-science
poppler-utils
libfontconfig1
libfreetype6
ffmpeg
dvisvgm
xvfb
libgl1-mesa-dri
libglx-mesa0
